subject: general
question: What is the full form of LASER?

options.text: Lower Application of System Emission of Radioactivity
Learning to Amplify and Stimulate Emission of Radiation
Light Addition to Systematic Electromagnetic Radiation
Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation

solution:
The correct answer is __**Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **LASER** stands for **Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation**.
 
• It is a device that emits light through a process of optical amplification based on the stimulated emission of electromagnetic radiation.
 
• LASERs are used in various applications including medicine, industry, and communications.
 
• The concept of stimulated emission was first proposed by Albert Einstein in 1917.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The first working LASER was built by Theodore H. Maiman at Hughes Research Laboratories in 1960.
 
• There are different types of LASERs such as gas lasers, solid-state lasers, and semiconductor lasers, each with unique properties and applications.
 
• LASER technology has evolved significantly and continues to be an area of active research and development.
